subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Inhibin, AMH and the Endometrial Phases

steps.tx: The granulosa peptide selectively suppressing pituitary FSH is **inhibin**. Inhibin B rises with the growing cohort, inhibin A dominates the luteal phase. Their fall at menopause releases FSH to climb. Inhibin B peaks in the mid follicular phase, inhibin A in the mid luteal, a pairing worth one line in notes.
steps.say: Inhibin selectively suppresses FSH, with B follicular and A luteal.

steps.tx: The hormone secreted by small growing follicles estimating ovarian reserve is **anti-Mullerian hormone**. It is cycle independent and predicts stimulation response in IVF. Very high levels associate with polycystic ovaries. Values fall with age years before FSH rises, so AMH is the earlier reserve marker of the two.
steps.say: Anti-Mullerian hormone estimates ovarian reserve independent of cycle day.

steps.tx: Endometrial growth under oestrogen after menstruation forms the **proliferative phase**. Glands straighten, stroma thickens and vessels regrow toward ovulation. It mirrors the follicular phase in the ovary. The phase lasts from day one to ovulation, variable in length, while the luteal phase stays near fourteen days.
steps.say: The proliferative phase regrows endometrium under oestrogen toward ovulation.

steps.tx: Progesterone converting the lining into a secretory, receptive state forms the **secretory phase**. Glands coil and secrete, stroma predecidualises around vessels. It mirrors the luteal phase and lasts a constant fourteen days. Subnuclear vacuoles in gland cells are the first histological sign that ovulation has occurred.
steps.say: The secretory phase converts the lining under progesterone for fourteen days.

steps.tx: The brief window when endometrium accepts implantation is the **window of implantation**. Pinopodes and adhesion molecules peak around day twenty to twenty four. Embryo and endometrium must synchronise within it. It opens six to ten days after the LH surge, which is why embryo transfer timing counts from ovulation, not menstruation.
steps.say: The window of implantation accepts the embryo around day twenty to twenty four.

steps.tx: Shedding follows progesterone withdrawal through spiral artery spasm, the mechanism of **menstruation**. Prostaglandins drive both cramping and vessel constriction. NSAIDs exploit this to lighten periods. Mephenamic acid started at the first sign of bleeding cuts loss by about a quarter in heavy periods.
steps.say: Menstruation follows progesterone withdrawal with spiral artery spasm and prostaglandins.

steps.tx: Endometrial thickness on ultrasound triples lines before ovulation in the **triple line sign**. A thin lining under seven millimetres at transfer lowers implantation in IVF. Postmenopausal thickness over four to five millimetres with bleeding needs sampling. A lining of 7 millimetres or more at transfer is the target most IVF units quote.
steps.say: Triple line endometrium heralds ovulation, and thin linings lower implantation.

steps.tx: Local endometrial haemostasis depends on vasoconstriction and platelet plugs, disturbed in **platelet disorders** causing heavy periods. Von Willebrand disease classically presents as heavy menstrual bleeding from menarche. Haematology screening belongs in adolescent heavy bleeding. Von Willebrand factor levels also dip at menstruation, worsening bleeding in affected women predictably.
steps.say: Von Willebrand disease classically presents as heavy menstrual bleeding from menarche.

steps.tx: Cycle length variation comes almost entirely from the follicular phase because luteal life is fixed, a principle of **follicular variability**. Long cycles mean late ovulation, not long luteal phases. This corrects day twenty one test timing. Day 21 progesterone in a 35 day cycle should be drawn at day 28, seven days before the next period.
steps.say: Follicular variability drives cycle length because the luteal phase is fixed.
